# Kyoto Family Trip Plan: 10–14 Apr 2026

A 5-day family itinerary built around low-walking days, temples, food, and one kid-friendly activity daily. Costs are estimated for **2 adults + 2 children** and kept within your **JPY 220,000** target, excluding international flights.

## Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary

### Day 1: Higashiyama Welcome Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Plan:** Kiyomizu-dera area, Sannenzaka/Ninenzaka, Yasaka Shrine, Gion evening stroll
- **Kid-friendly activity:** Kimono rental photo stop or sweets tasting on Sannenzaka
- **Transit tip:** Use bus/taxi to reduce uphill walking; start at Kiyomizu-dera and walk mostly downhill
- **Meal idea:** Lunch near Higashiyama; dinner with yudofu or tempura set in Gion
- **Rainy-day backup:** Kyoto National Museum + café time in Higashiyama
- **Estimated cost:** **JPY 34,000**
  - Local transit/taxi: 4,000
  - Admissions/activity: 8,000
  - Meals: 18,000
  - Snacks/contingency: 4,000

### Day 2: Arashiyama and Monkey Park
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- **Plan:** Arashiyama Bamboo Grove, Tenryu-ji, Togetsukyo Bridge, Iwatayama Monkey Park
Media: Alt=Plan:** Arashiyama Bamboo Grove, Tenryu-ji, Togetsukyo Bridge, Iwatayama Monkey Park, Kyoto, Japan
- **Kid-friendly activity:** Monkey Park climb and river views
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/ea/Iwatayama_Monkey_Kyoto.jpg Alt=Kid-friendly activity:** Monkey Park climb and river views, Kyoto, Japan
- **Transit tip:** Take the JR Sagano Line or Hankyu to Arashiyama; use local bus only for short hops
- **Meal idea:** Tofu lunch, then matcha soft serve and riverfront snacks
- **Rainy-day backup:** Kyoto Railway Museum or Arashiyama shopping streets with covered arcades
- **Estimated cost:** **JPY 39,000**
  - Transit: 4,000
  - Admissions/activity: 10,000
  - Meals: 20,000
  - Snacks/contingency: 5,000

### Day 3: Fushimi Inari and Sake District
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- **Plan:** Early Fushimi Inari, Fushimi sake district, Byodo-in area if energy allows
- **Kid-friendly activity:** Torii gate “treasure hunt” and stamp-style photo challenge
- **Transit tip:** Go early by JR to avoid crowds; keep the shrine visit to the lower trails to stay under step limits
- **Meal idea:** Udon or rice bowls near Fushimi; dessert stop with mochi
- **Rainy-day backup:** Kyoto Aquarium or Kyoto Municipal Science Center
- **Estimated cost:** **JPY 33,000**
  - Transit: 3,000
  - Admissions/activity: 7,000
  - Meals: 19,000
  - Snacks/contingency: 4,000

### Day 4: Central Kyoto Temples and Market Eats
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- **Plan:** Nishiki Market, Nijo Castle, Kyoto Imperial Palace area, optional short temple stop
Media: Alt=Plan:** Nishiki Market, Nijo Castle, Kyoto Imperial Palace area, optional short temple stop, Kyoto, Japan
- **Kid-friendly activity:** Market tasting challenge and castle grounds exploration
- **Transit tip:** Use subway between central stops; this is the easiest low-step day
- **Meal idea:** Small-plate lunch at Nishiki Market, casual izakaya-style dinner or family restaurant
- **Rainy-day backup:** Stay mostly indoors with market food, castle interiors, and department-store food halls
- **Estimated cost:** **JPY 41,000**
  - Transit: 3,000
  - Admissions/activity: 9,000
  - Meals: 24,000
  - Snacks/contingency: 5,000

### Day 5: Northern Kyoto and Farewell Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Plan:** Kinkaku-ji, Ryoan-ji, short Zen garden visit, final shopping stop
- **Kid-friendly activity:** Rock-garden spotting game and souvenir hunt
- **Transit tip:** Use taxi between Kinkaku-ji and Ryoan-ji to save steps and time
- **Meal idea:** Final lunch with soba or tonkatsu; dessert café before departure prep
- **Rainy-day backup:** Kyoto International Manga Museum or Kyoto Station area shopping
- **Estimated cost:** **JPY 31,000**
  - Transit: 4,000
  - Admissions/activity: 6,000
  - Meals: 17,000
  - Snacks/contingency: 4,000

## Cost Plan and Step Control

| Day | Main Focus | Est. Cost | Step Goal | Low-Walk Strategy |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | Higashiyama temples + Gion | JPY 34,000 | 8,000–9,500 | Taxi/bus to start high, walk downhill |
| 2 | Arashiyama + monkeys | JPY 39,000 | 8,500–10,000 | Use train + short local transfers |
| 3 | Fushimi Inari + sake district | JPY 33,000 | 6,000–8,500 | Stay on lower shrine trails only |
| 4 | Market + castle + palace area | JPY 41,000 | 5,500–8,000 | Subway-heavy day, compact city routing |
| 5 | Kinkaku-ji + Ryoan-ji | JPY 31,000 | 6,500–8,500 | Taxi between northern sights |

## Budget Fit for 2 Adults + 2 Children

- **Total estimated trip cost:** **JPY 178,000**
- **Budget remaining:** **JPY 42,000**
- Best use for the remaining buffer:
  - better dinner one night
  - extra taxi rides to protect step count
  - souvenir budget
  - weather-flexibility for rainy-day indoor tickets

## Transit and Dining Strategy

- **Best transport mix:** JR + subway + short taxi rides
- **Avoid:** long bus-only routes during peak sightseeing hours
- **Meal strategy:** 1 sit-down lunch, 1 lighter lunch, 1 market lunch, 1 family dinner, 1 flexible snack-heavy day
- **Kid-friendly food picks:** udon, curry rice, tempura, tamagoyaki, mochi, matcha sweets, soft serve, onigiri

## Quick Actions

- Kyoto tourism guide: https://kyoto.travel/en
